title: The Elder Scrolls IV: Oblivion® Game of the Year Edition (2009)

quotes.text: Golly, you're the best! I'm going to follow you and watch you and worship the ground you walk on! Let's go!
Find him, and close shut the jaws of Oblivion.
17 voice actors voiced 1,497 NPCs — a ratio you can hear in every tavern conversation.
Todd Howard voiced one NPC himself: the Daedric Prince Clavicus Vile.
Every player spends the whole game trying not to look at NPC faces too closely.
You get arrested for trespassing in your own house because a guard saw you climb through the window.
By the twentieth Oblivion Gate, you're closing them out of obligation, not heroism.

notes: DELIBERATE CHOICE: Nexus's 'oblivion' domain is the ORIGINAL 2006 Oblivion, not the 2025 Oblivion Remastered (which has its own separate Nexus domain/appid, 2623190, and is not this entry). appid 22330 is the only Oblivion SKU Steam currently sells — its storefront listing and appdetails title itself as 'Game of the Year Edition (2009)' (bundling the Shivering Isles and Knights of the Nine expansions), but this is the same base-game appid the original 2006 release has always used on Steam; there is no separate un-bundled 'vanilla' Oblivion appid to choose instead, so 22330 is correct and deliberate. title/studio copied verbatim from Steam appdetails (type=game, developer Bethesda Game Studios, publisher Bethesda Softworks), including the registered-trademark glyph and parenthetical '(2009)' Steam itself displays. Character quotes verified verbatim against UESP (fetched via curl with a browser User-Agent; UESP 403s on default UA) and Elder Scrolls Fandom's MediaWiki API (api.php?action=parse; plain HTML fetches on fandom domains also 403 via Cloudflare for both curl and WebFetch). The Uriel Septim line is an excerpt from a single unbroken in-game sentence, not a splice of separate lines.
